verdict.rationale: AvaTax offers a well-documented public REST v2 API with detailed method docs (CreateTransaction, CreateNexus), SDKs in six languages, interactive API Explorer with sample payloads, and a free trial for testing—clearly a documented, programmatically drivable API. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s) which would strengthen machine-readability for AI-native consumption.
